title: Section 26 BSA — Statement of a person who is dead or cannot be found

content.heading: Cases in which statement of relevant fact by person who is dead or cannot be found, etc., is relevant
content.text: Statements, written or verbal, of relevant facts made by a person who is dead, or who cannot be found, or who has become incapable of giving evidence, or whose attendance cannot be procured without unreasonable delay or expense, are relevant in the cases enacted, including a statement as to the cause of death. This is the successor of Evidence Act section 32.
